source.text: וְנֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תַקְרִ֞יב קָרְבַּ֤ן מִנְחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת יִהְיֶ֣ה קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְיָצַ֤ק עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְנָתַ֥ן עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] person when [one] brings near [an] offering of [a] grain offering to Yahweh, fine flour will be his offering, and he will pour on it oil and put on it frankincense.

en.L: And when a person brings near an offering, a grain offering, to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, his offering shall be fine flour; and he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.
en.B: If anyone brings a grain offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as their offering, it must be fine flour. Oil is to be poured over the flour and frankincense placed on it.
en.R: If you bring a grain offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, it must be fine flour. Pour oil over the flour and put frankincense on top.

es.L: Y cuando alguien presente una ofrenda, una ofrenda de cereal, {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, su ofrenda será flor de harina; y derramará sobre ella aceite y pondrá sobre ella incienso.
es.B: Si alguien trae {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda de cereal, será de flor de harina. Se le echará aceite por encima y se le pondrá incienso.
es.R: Si traes una ofrenda de cereal {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, tiene que ser de harina fina. Échale aceite a la harina y ponle incienso encima.

fr.L: Et lorsque quelqu’un fera approcher une offrande, une offrande végétale, {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, son offrande sera de la fleur de farine ; il versera sur elle de l’huile et mettra sur elle de l’encens.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un présente {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une offrande végétale, son offrande sera de la fleur de farine. On versera de l’huile sur la farine et on y mettra de l’encens.
fr.R: Si tu apportes une offrande végétale {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, ce doit être de la farine fine. Verse de l’huile sur la farine et mets de l’encens dessus.

sw.L: Na mtu atakapomsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka, sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka yake itakuwa unga laini; naye atamimina mafuta juu yake na kuweka ubani juu yake.
sw.B: Mtu akimletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya nafaka, itakuwa ya unga laini. Mafuta yatamiminwa juu ya unga huo na ubani utawekwa juu yake.
sw.R: Ukimletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya nafaka, lazima iwe unga laini. Mimina mafuta juu ya unga huo na uweke ubani juu yake.

decisions.choice: grain offering: a gift to God of grain or flour
decisions.reason: The word means a gift or tribute. It is used of the gifts of Cain and Abel (Genesis 4:3-5), of Jacob's present to Esau (Genesis 32:13) and of tribute paid to a king (Judges 3:15). In the laws of offering it is the gift of grain: fine flour (verse 1), baked or cooked cakes (verses 4-7) or roasted new grain (verse 14). It is often brought together with a burnt offering or a peace offering (Numbers 15:1-10). Only a handful is burned; the rest is food for the priests (verse 3).

decisions.choice: a person: anyone, man or woman
decisions.reason: The word often means life or soul, but here, as often in the laws, it means a person, whoever that may be. The law does not limit the grain offering to men. The Hebrew uses a feminine verb with this word and then says "his offering" and "he" for the person, as Hebrew does with an indefinite subject.

decisions.choice: fine flour: the best, finely ground flour
decisions.reason: This flour is distinct from ordinary flour (1 Kings 4:22, where the king's household uses both). It was most likely wheat ground fine, the best part of the meal (Exodus 29:2 speaks of fine flour of wheat). It is the flour of the offerings and of the bread of the Presence (24:5).

decisions.choice: oil and frankincense: olive oil, and a fragrant resin burned as incense
decisions.reason: The oil is olive oil, used in cooking and in lamps. Frankincense is the gum of trees that grow in southern Arabia and East Africa, brought by traders from far away (Jeremiah 6:20). It gives off a sweet smell when burned and is part of the holy incense (Exodus 30:34). All of it is burned with the handful from the offering (verse 2).

decisions.choice: their offering; passives (Balanced); you (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "his offering" and "he shall pour" for a person who may be a man or a woman. Literal keeps "his" and "he"; Balanced says "their" and uses passives; Readable speaks to the reader as "you", as in chapter 1.

decisions.choice: "la ofrenda de cereal" at every level; "flor de harina" (L, B), "harina fina" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the offering is a gift of grain or flour (m1), and "ofrenda de cereal" says so plainly. "Flor de harina" is the traditional name for the best, finely ground flour (m3); Readable says "harina fina". Frankincense is "incienso".

decisions.choice: "l'offrande végétale" at every level; "la fleur de farine" (L, B), "la farine fine" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the offering is a gift of grain or flour (m1); "offrande végétale" names it plainly, where "oblation" is a word few readers know. "Fleur de farine" is the traditional name for the best, finely ground flour (m3); Readable says "farine fine". Frankincense is "l'encens".

decisions.choice: "sadaka ya nafaka" at every level; "unga laini" for the fine flour
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the offering is a gift of grain, whether flour, baked cakes or roasted grain (m1), so "nafaka" (grain) fits every kind. "Unga laini" is the finely ground flour (m3). Oil is "mafuta", frankincense "ubani".

source.text: וֶֽהֱבִיאָ֗הּ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹן֮ הַכֹּהֲנִים֒ וְקָמַ֨ץ מִשָּׁ֜ם מְלֹ֣א קֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסָּלְתָּהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־אַזְכָּרָתָהּ֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will bring it to [the] sons of Aaron, the priests, and he will take from there [the] fullness of his handful from its fine flour and from its oil, with all its frankincense, and will make smoke the priest its memorial portion on the altar, [a] fire offering, [an] odor of soothing to Yahweh.

en.L: And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and he shall take from there his full handful of its fine flour and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall make its memorial portion smoke on the altar, an offering by fire, an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: They are to bring it to Aaron's sons, the priests. A priest is to scoop out a full handful of the flour and oil, along with all of the frankincense, and turn this memorial portion into smoke on the altar. It is a food offering, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Bring it to Aaron's sons, the priests. One of the priests will take a full handful of the flour and oil and all the frankincense. He will burn this on the altar. It is the part that is a reminder. It is a food offering burned on the fire, a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y la llevará a los hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes, y tomará de allí un puñado lleno de su flor de harina y de su aceite, con todo su incienso, y el sacerdote hará humear su porción memorial sobre el altar, ofrenda quemada, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Se llevará a los hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes. Un sacerdote tomará un puñado lleno de la harina y del aceite, junto con todo el incienso, y hará subir en humo esta porción memorial sobre el altar. Es una ofrenda quemada, de aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Llévala a los hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes. Uno de los sacerdotes tomará un buen puñado de la harina y del aceite, y todo el incienso. Lo quemará en el altar. Es la parte que sirve de recuerdo. Es una ofrenda quemada en el fuego, de olor agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il l’apportera aux fils d’Aaron, les prêtres, et il prendra de là une pleine poignée de sa fleur de farine et de son huile, avec tout son encens, et le prêtre fera fumer sa portion commémorative sur l’autel, offrande consumée par le feu, odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: On l’apportera aux fils d’Aaron, les prêtres. Un prêtre prendra une pleine poignée de farine et d’huile, avec tout l’encens, et fera monter cette portion commémorative en fumée sur l’autel. C’est une offrande consumée par le feu, une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Apporte-la aux fils d’Aaron, les prêtres. L’un des prêtres prendra une pleine poignée de farine et d’huile, et tout l’encens. Il brûlera cela sur l’autel. C’est la part qui sert de rappel. C’est une offrande brûlée sur le feu, une odeur qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye ataipeleka kwa wana wa Haruni, makuhani, naye atachukua humo konzi nzima ya unga wake laini na ya mafuta yake, pamoja na ubani wake wote, naye kuhani ataifukiza sehemu yake ya ukumbusho juu ya madhabahu, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ataipeleka kwa wana wa Haruni, makuhani. Kuhani atachukua konzi nzima ya unga na mafuta, pamoja na ubani wote, na kuifukiza sehemu hiyo ya ukumbusho juu ya madhabahu. Ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ipeleke kwa wana wa Haruni, makuhani. Mmoja wa makuhani atachukua konzi nzima ya unga na mafuta, na ubani wote. Atavichoma juu ya madhabahu. Hii ndiyo sehemu ya kukumbusha. Ni sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto, harufu inayompendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: its memorial portion: the part burned on the altar that stands for the whole offering
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "remember". The handful burned on the altar represents the whole gift, and the rest is given to the priests (verse 3). The same word is used of the frankincense set on the bread of the Presence (24:7), of the handful from a poor person's sin offering (5:12) and from the offering of jealousy (Numbers 5:26). It may mean that the offering calls the worshiper to God's remembrance, or simply that it is the token portion given to God; both ideas may be present.

decisions.choice: he will take a handful: the priest
decisions.reason: The first "he" is the worshiper, who brings the offering. The one who takes the handful is most likely the priest, who is then named as the one who burns it; 6:8 says plainly that the priest takes the handful. The handful is taken from the flour mixed with oil, while all the frankincense goes with it.

decisions.choice: a fire offering, an odor of soothing: as in 1:9
decisions.reason: The grain offering is described with the same words as the burnt offering (1:9). See the notes there.

decisions.choice: They; A priest (Balanced); One of the priests (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he" for both the worshiper and the priest. Balanced uses "they" for the worshiper, who may be a man or a woman, and names the priest as the one who takes the handful; Readable does the same and speaks to the worshiper as "you".

decisions.choice: "la porción memorial" (L, B); "la parte que sirve de recuerdo" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the word comes from "remember" and names the handful burned for the whole gift (m1). "Porción memorial" keeps both the link with remembering and the idea of a portion; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "la portion commémorative" (L, B); "la part qui sert de rappel" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the word comes from "remember" and names the handful burned for the whole gift (m1). "Portion commémorative" keeps both the link with remembering and the idea of a portion; "le mémorial" alone would suggest a monument. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "sehemu ya ukumbusho" (L, B); "sehemu ya kukumbusha" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the word comes from "remember" and names the handful burned for the whole gift (m1). "Sehemu ya ukumbusho" keeps both the portion and the link with remembering. A handful is "konzi".

source.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מִן־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the remainder of the grain offering [belongs] to Aaron and to his sons, [a] holy thing of holy things from the fire offerings of Yahweh.

en.L: And the remainder of the grain offering [belongs] to Aaron and to his sons, a most holy [thing] from the offerings by fire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Whatever remains of the grain offering goes to Aaron and his sons, a share that is most holy, taken from the food offerings of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The rest of the grain offering is for Aaron and his sons. It is very holy. It is their share of the food offerings burned for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y el resto de la ofrenda de cereal [será] para Aarón y para sus hijos, [cosa] santísima de las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Lo que quede de la ofrenda de cereal será para Aarón y sus hijos; es una porción santísima, tomada de las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El resto de la ofrenda de cereal es para Aarón y sus hijos. Es muy santo. Es la parte que les toca de las ofrendas quemadas para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le reste de l’offrande végétale [sera] pour Aaron et pour ses fils, une [chose] très sainte parmi les offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ce qui reste de l’offrande végétale revient à Aaron et à ses fils : c’est une part très sainte, prise sur les offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le reste de l’offrande végétale est pour Aaron et ses fils. C’est très saint. C’est leur part des offrandes brûlées pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na kinachobaki cha sadaka ya nafaka [ni] cha Haruni na wanawe, [kitu] kitakatifu kabisa katika sadaka za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} za kuteketezwa kwa moto.
sw.B: Kitakachobaki cha sadaka ya nafaka ni cha Haruni na wanawe; ni sehemu takatifu kabisa, iliyotolewa katika sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Sehemu iliyobaki ya sadaka ya nafaka ni ya Haruni na wanawe. Ni takatifu sana. Ni fungu lao la sadaka zilizochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: a holy thing of holy things: most holy, belonging to God in the highest degree
decisions.reason: "Holy of holies" is the Hebrew way of saying "most holy"; the same phrase names the inner room of the tent (Exodus 26:33). Among the offerings, those that are most holy are the grain offering (6:10), the sin offering (6:18, 22) and the guilt offering (7:1, 6), and also the bread of the Presence (24:9). Only the priests may eat them, and only in a holy place (6:9-11). The peace offering, by contrast, is eaten by the worshiper and guests (7:15-21).

decisions.choice: the remainder goes to the priests
decisions.reason: Only the handful is burned. The rest of the flour is food for the priests, who own no land of their own (Numbers 18:9-10, 20). It is given to them from what belongs to God.

decisions.choice: from the fire offerings of Yahweh: part of what is given to Yahweh
decisions.reason: The priests' share is taken from offerings that belong to Yahweh. They eat it as God's gift to them (6:10), not as something the worshiper gives them directly.

decisions.choice: very holy
decisions.reason: Literal says "a most holy [thing]" and Balanced "most holy". Readable says "very holy" in common words.

decisions.choice: "santísimo" (L, B); "muy santo" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the Hebrew "holy of holies" means "most holy" (m1), which Spanish says with the superlative "santísimo", as in "el lugar santísimo". Literal brackets "[cosa]", as the English brackets "[thing]".

decisions.choice: "très saint" at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the Hebrew "holy of holies" means "most holy" (m1), which French says with "très saint", as in "le lieu très saint". Literal brackets "[chose]", as the English brackets "[thing]".

decisions.choice: "takatifu kabisa" (L, B); "takatifu sana" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: the Hebrew "holy of holies" means "most holy" (m1). "Takatifu kabisa" says it as the terms doc says "Patakatifu pa Patakatifu" for the room; Readable says "takatifu sana", as the English Readable says "very holy".

source.text: וְכִ֥י תַקְרִ֛ב קָרְבַּ֥ן מִנְחָ֖ה מַאֲפֵ֣ה תַנּ֑וּר סֹ֣לֶת חַלּ֤וֹת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֥ים בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And when you bring near [an] offering of [a] grain offering, [a] baked thing of [an] oven, fine flour, cakes of unleavened [bread] mixed with oil and wafers of unleavened [bread] smeared with oil.

en.L: And when you bring near an offering of a grain offering baked in an oven, [it shall be] fine flour: unleavened cakes mixed with oil and unleavened wafers smeared with oil.
en.B: When your grain offering is something baked in an oven, it must be of fine flour: cakes made without yeast and mixed with oil, or wafers made without yeast and spread with oil.
en.R: If you bake your grain offering in an oven, use fine flour. Make it without yeast. You can make cakes with oil mixed in. Or you can make thin wafers with oil spread on top.

es.L: Y cuando presentes una ofrenda de cereal cocida en horno, [será de] flor de harina: tortas sin levadura amasadas con aceite y obleas sin levadura untadas con aceite.
es.B: Cuando tu ofrenda de cereal sea algo cocido al horno, será de flor de harina: tortas sin levadura amasadas con aceite, u obleas sin levadura untadas con aceite.
es.R: Si cueces tu ofrenda de cereal en el horno, usa harina fina. Hazla sin levadura. Puedes hacer tortas con aceite mezclado en la masa. O puedes hacer obleas delgadas con aceite untado por encima.

fr.L: Et lorsque tu feras approcher une offrande, une offrande végétale cuite au four, [ce sera] de la fleur de farine : des gâteaux sans levain pétris à l’huile et des galettes sans levain enduites d’huile.
fr.B: Quand ton offrande végétale sera cuite au four, elle sera de fleur de farine : des gâteaux sans levain pétris avec de l’huile, ou des galettes sans levain enduites d’huile.
fr.R: Si tu fais cuire ton offrande végétale au four, prends de la farine fine. Fais-la sans levain. Tu peux faire des gâteaux avec de l’huile dans la pâte. Ou tu peux faire des galettes fines avec de l’huile étalée dessus.

sw.L: Na utakaposogeza sadaka ya nafaka iliyookwa tanurini, [itakuwa] unga laini: mikate isiyotiwa chachu iliyochanganywa na mafuta, na mikate myembamba isiyotiwa chachu iliyopakwa mafuta.
sw.B: Sadaka yako ya nafaka ikiwa imeokwa tanurini, itakuwa ya unga laini: mikate isiyotiwa chachu iliyokandwa na mafuta, au mikate myembamba isiyotiwa chachu iliyopakwa mafuta.
sw.R: Ukioka sadaka yako ya nafaka tanurini, tumia unga laini. Usitie chachu. Unaweza kuoka mikate iliyochanganywa na mafuta. Au unaweza kuoka mikate myembamba iliyopakwa mafuta juu.

decisions.choice: unleavened: made without leaven, so that the dough does not rise
decisions.reason: Leaven was a piece of fermented dough kept back from an earlier batch and worked into new dough to make it rise. Unleavened bread is flat bread made without it, like the bread of the Passover (Exodus 12:15-20, 39). Every grain offering burned on the altar must be unleavened (verse 11), and the priests eat their share unleavened as well (6:9-10).

decisions.choice: cakes and wafers: thicker round loaves, and thin wafers
decisions.reason: The word for the cakes is probably related to a verb meaning to pierce, and may describe loaves that were pierced or ring-shaped; they were thicker, with the oil mixed into the dough. The wafers were thin, with oil smeared over them after baking. Both appear among the offerings at the priests' ordination (Exodus 29:2; 8:26).

decisions.choice: you: the law now speaks to the worshiper directly
decisions.reason: From this verse the Hebrew addresses the worshiper as "you" (singular). The "and" between the cakes and the wafers most likely lists two kinds of oven offering, either of which may be brought, not two things to be brought together.

decisions.choice: or (Balanced); Or you can (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the cakes and wafers with "and". Balanced and Readable say "or", because these are two kinds of the same offering. Readable splits the verse into short sentences and adds "thin" to explain "wafers".

decisions.choice: "tortas" for the cakes, "obleas" for the wafers; "sin levadura" at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: "tortas" are the thicker round loaves with the oil in the dough, "obleas" the thin wafers smeared with oil (m2). Spanish "levadura" serves for both the biblical leaven and modern yeast, so the English Literal/Balanced difference does not arise.

decisions.choice: "des gâteaux" for the cakes, "des galettes" for the wafers; "sans levain" at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: "gâteaux" are the thicker round loaves with the oil in the dough, "galettes" the thin wafers (m2). French keeps "levain" at every level: it is the everyday word for the fermented dough that the Bible means (m1), whereas "levure" is modern yeast.

decisions.choice: "mikate" for the cakes, "mikate myembamba" for the wafers; "isiyotiwa chachu" at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: Swahili has no separate common words for these two breads, so the wafers are "thin breads" (m2). "Chachu" serves for both the biblical leaven and modern yeast; "isiyotiwa chachu" matches the name of the Feast of Unleavened Bread. An oven is "tanuri".

source.text: וְאִם־מִנְחָ֥ה עַל־הַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן מַצָּ֥ה תִהְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if [a] grain offering on the griddle [is] your offering, fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened [bread] it will be.

en.L: And if your offering [is] a grain offering on the griddle, it shall be fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened.
en.B: If you offer a grain offering cooked on a flat griddle, the fine flour must be mixed with oil and made without yeast.
en.R: If you cook your grain offering on a flat pan, use fine flour mixed with oil. Do not use yeast.

es.L: Y si tu ofrenda [es] ofrenda de cereal [hecha] en la plancha, será flor de harina amasada con aceite, sin levadura.
es.B: Si ofreces una ofrenda de cereal cocida en una plancha, la flor de harina será amasada con aceite y sin levadura.
es.R: Si cocinas tu ofrenda de cereal en una sartén plana, usa harina fina mezclada con aceite. No uses levadura.

fr.L: Et si ton offrande [est] une offrande végétale [cuite] sur la plaque, elle sera de fleur de farine pétrie à l’huile, sans levain.
fr.B: Si tu offres une offrande végétale cuite sur une plaque, la fleur de farine sera pétrie avec de l’huile et sans levain.
fr.R: Si tu fais cuire ton offrande végétale sur une poêle plate, prends de la farine fine mélangée avec de l’huile. N’utilise pas de levain.

sw.L: Na kama sadaka yako [ni] sadaka ya nafaka [iliyopikwa] juu ya kikaango bapa, itakuwa unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, usiotiwa chachu.
sw.B: Ukitoa sadaka ya nafaka iliyopikwa juu ya kikaango bapa, unga laini utachanganywa na mafuta na hautatiwa chachu.
sw.R: Ukipika sadaka yako ya nafaka juu ya kikaango bapa, tumia unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta. Usitie chachu.

decisions.choice: the griddle: a flat plate for baking over a fire
decisions.reason: This was a flat plate of clay or iron set over the fire, on which flat bread was baked. Ezekiel uses an iron one as a wall in a sign-action (Ezekiel 4:3). The priests' daily grain offering was prepared on one (6:14).

decisions.choice: unleavened: as in verse 4
decisions.reason: Like the oven offering, the griddle offering is made without leaven. See the note at verse 4.

decisions.choice: a flat pan
decisions.reason: Readable says "a flat pan", a common word for the griddle.

decisions.choice: "la plancha" (L, B); "una sartén plana" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: a flat plate of clay or iron set over the fire (m1) is a "plancha"; "sartén" is kept at Readable, where the English says "a flat pan", and "cazuela" for the deep pan of verse 7.

decisions.choice: "la plaque" (L, B); "une poêle plate" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: a flat plate of clay or iron set over the fire (m1) is a "plaque" for baking; Readable says "poêle plate", where the English says "a flat pan", and "casserole" is kept for the deep pan of verse 7.

decisions.choice: "kikaango bapa" at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: a flat plate set over the fire (m1), the kind on which chapati are cooked, is "kikaango bapa" (flat pan) in common words; "sufuria" is kept for the deep pan of verse 7.

source.text: פָּת֤וֹת אֹתָהּ֙ פִּתִּ֔ים וְיָצַקְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ שָׁ֑מֶן מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Crumbling it [into] crumbs, and you will pour on it oil; [a] grain offering it [is].

en.L: Break it in pieces and pour oil on it; it [is] a grain offering.
en.B: Break it up into crumbs, then pour oil over it. This is a grain offering.
en.R: Break it into small pieces and pour oil on them. This is a grain offering.

es.L: Pártela en pedazos y derrama sobre ella aceite; ofrenda de cereal [es].
es.B: La desmenuzarás y luego le echarás aceite por encima. Es una ofrenda de cereal.
es.R: Pártela en pedacitos y échales aceite. Es una ofrenda de cereal.

fr.L: Romps-la en morceaux et verse sur elle de l’huile ; c’[est] une offrande végétale.
fr.B: Tu l’émietteras, puis tu verseras de l’huile dessus. C’est une offrande végétale.
fr.R: Romps-la en petits morceaux et verse de l’huile dessus. C’est une offrande végétale.

sw.L: Ivunje vipande vipande na kumimina mafuta juu yake; [ni] sadaka ya nafaka.
sw.B: Utaimega vipande vidogo, kisha utamimina mafuta juu yake. Hii ni sadaka ya nafaka.
sw.R: Ivunje vipande vidogo na umimine mafuta juu yake. Hii ni sadaka ya nafaka.

decisions.choice: crumbling it into crumbs: break it into pieces
decisions.reason: The verb form here works as a command, and it is followed by a noun from the same root: break it into broken bits. The text gives no reason. The pieces may let the oil soak in, and they make it easy for the priest to take a handful (verse 2).

decisions.choice: it is a grain offering: a closing formula
decisions.reason: The short sentence closes the rule for this kind of grain offering, as "it is a burnt offering" closes each rule in chapter 1. It returns in verse 15.

source.text: וְאִם־מִנְחַ֥ת מַרְחֶ֖שֶׁת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֥לֶת בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן תֵּעָשֶֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if [a] grain offering of [a] pan [is] your offering, fine flour with oil it will be made.

en.L: And if your offering [is] a grain offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
en.B: A grain offering that you cook in a deep pan must be made of fine flour and oil.
en.R: If you cook your grain offering in a deep pan, make it from fine flour and oil.

es.L: Y si tu ofrenda [es] ofrenda de cereal de cazuela, se hará de flor de harina con aceite.
es.B: La ofrenda de cereal que cocines en una cazuela honda se hará de flor de harina y aceite.
es.R: Si cocinas tu ofrenda de cereal en una cazuela honda, hazla con harina fina y aceite.

fr.L: Et si ton offrande [est] une offrande végétale de la casserole, elle sera faite de fleur de farine avec de l’huile.
fr.B: L’offrande végétale que tu cuis dans une casserole profonde sera faite de fleur de farine et d’huile.
fr.R: Si tu fais cuire ton offrande végétale dans une casserole profonde, fais-la avec de la farine fine et de l’huile.

sw.L: Na ikiwa sadaka yako [ni] sadaka ya nafaka ya sufuria, itafanywa kwa unga laini pamoja na mafuta.
sw.B: Sadaka ya nafaka utakayoipika katika sufuria yenye kina itafanywa kwa unga laini na mafuta.
sw.R: Ukipika sadaka yako ya nafaka katika sufuria yenye kina, itengeneze kwa unga laini na mafuta.

decisions.choice: a pan: probably a deep pan in which the dough was cooked in oil
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here and in 7:9. It seems to come from a root meaning to stir or bubble (Psalm 45:2, "my heart is stirring"), and so probably names a deep pan in which the dough was cooked in a good amount of oil, unlike the flat griddle of verse 5. Its exact shape is not known.

decisions.choice: it will be made: unleavened, like the others
decisions.reason: This verse does not repeat "unleavened", but the rule of verse 11 covers every grain offering.

decisions.choice: "cazuela" (L); "cazuela honda" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A deep pan in which dough was cooked in oil (m1). "Cazuela" keeps it apart from the flat "plancha" of verse 5.

decisions.choice: "la casserole" (L); "une casserole profonde" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A deep pan in which dough was cooked in oil (m1). "Casserole" keeps it apart from the flat "plaque" of verse 5; "marmite" suggests a large pot for stew.

decisions.choice: "sufuria" (L); "sufuria yenye kina" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A deep pan in which dough was cooked in oil (m1). "Sufuria" keeps it apart from the flat "kikaango bapa" of verse 5.

source.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ֣ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִגִּישָׁ֖הּ אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will bring the grain offering which will be made from these to Yahweh, and he will present it to the priest, and he will bring it near to the altar.

en.L: And you shall bring the grain offering that is made of these [things] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he shall present it to the priest, and he shall bring it near to the altar.
en.B: Whichever of these ways your grain offering is made, you are to bring it to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Once it is handed to the priest, he is to carry it to the altar.
en.R: Bring your grain offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Give it to the priest. He will take it up to the altar.

es.L: Y traerás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} la ofrenda de cereal que se haga de estas [cosas], y él la presentará al sacerdote, y él la acercará al altar.
es.B: De cualquiera de estas maneras que se prepare tu ofrenda de cereal, la llevarás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Cuando se le entregue al sacerdote, él la llevará al altar.
es.R: Lleva tu ofrenda de cereal {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Dásela al sacerdote. Él la llevará al altar.

fr.L: Et tu apporteras {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} l’offrande végétale qui sera faite de ces [choses], et il la présentera au prêtre, et il la fera approcher de l’autel.
fr.B: De quelque manière que ton offrande végétale soit préparée, tu l’apporteras {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Une fois qu’elle aura été remise au prêtre, celui-ci la portera à l’autel.
fr.R: Apporte ton offrande végétale {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Donne-la au prêtre. Il la portera jusqu’à l’autel.

sw.L: Nawe utamletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya nafaka itakayofanywa kwa [vitu] hivi, naye ataikabidhi kwa kuhani, naye ataisogeza kwenye madhabahu.
sw.B: Kwa njia yoyote kati ya hizi sadaka yako ya nafaka itakavyoandaliwa, utamletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ikishakabidhiwa kwa kuhani, yeye ataipeleka kwenye madhabahu.
sw.R: Mletee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka yako ya nafaka. Mpe kuhani. Yeye ataipeleka hadi kwenye madhabahu.

decisions.choice: you will bring ... he will present ... he will bring near: the worshiper hands the offering to the priest
alternatives: it is presented to the priest
decisions.reason: The verse moves from "you" to "he". The one who presents the offering to the priest is most likely the worshiper again, spoken of in the third person, or anyone who brings it; the one who brings it near to the altar is the priest.

decisions.choice: bring it near to the altar: set it before the altar
decisions.reason: The priest sets the offering down at the front of the altar, the side facing the tent (6:7), before taking the handful to burn (verse 9).

decisions.choice: Whichever of these ways (Balanced); Give it (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "whichever of these ways" for "made from these", and uses a passive for the change to "he". Readable speaks to the reader as "you" throughout.

source.text: וְהֵרִ֨ים הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן־הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will lift up the priest from the grain offering its memorial portion and make [it] smoke on the altar, [a] fire offering, [an] odor of soothing to Yahweh.

en.L: And the priest shall lift up from the grain offering its memorial portion and make [it] smoke on the altar, an offering by fire, an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: From the grain offering the priest is to lift out its memorial portion and turn it into smoke on the altar. It is a food offering, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The priest will take out the part that is a reminder and burn it on the altar. It is a food offering burned on the fire, a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y el sacerdote alzará de la ofrenda de cereal su porción memorial y [la] hará humear sobre el altar, ofrenda quemada, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: El sacerdote apartará de la ofrenda de cereal su porción memorial y la hará subir en humo sobre el altar. Es una ofrenda quemada, de aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: El sacerdote sacará la parte que sirve de recuerdo y la quemará en el altar. Es una ofrenda quemada en el fuego, de olor agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le prêtre prélèvera de l’offrande végétale sa portion commémorative et [la] fera fumer sur l’autel, offrande consumée par le feu, odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le prêtre prélèvera de l’offrande végétale sa portion commémorative et la fera monter en fumée sur l’autel. C’est une offrande consumée par le feu, une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le prêtre prendra la part qui sert de rappel et la brûlera sur l’autel. C’est une offrande brûlée sur le feu, une odeur qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye kuhani ataiinua kutoka kwa sadaka ya nafaka sehemu yake ya ukumbusho na kuifukiza juu ya madhabahu, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kuhani atatenga kutoka kwa sadaka ya nafaka sehemu yake ya ukumbusho na kuifukiza juu ya madhabahu. Ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kuhani atatoa sehemu ya kukumbusha na kuichoma juu ya madhabahu. Ni sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto, harufu inayompendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: lift up: take off a portion and set it apart
decisions.reason: The verb is used for removing the part of an offering that goes to the altar, as with the fat of the sin offering (4:8, 10) and the handful of the grain offering (6:8). For a baked offering the memorial portion is broken off from the cakes.

decisions.choice: its memorial portion ... a soothing aroma: as in verse 2
decisions.reason: The baked offerings are treated like the flour of verse 2. See the notes at verse 2 and 1:9.

source.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מִן־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the remainder of the grain offering [belongs] to Aaron and to his sons, [a] holy thing of holy things from the fire offerings of Yahweh.

en.L: And the remainder of the grain offering [belongs] to Aaron and to his sons, a most holy [thing] from the offerings by fire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Whatever remains of the grain offering goes to Aaron and his sons, a share that is most holy, taken from the food offerings of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The rest of the grain offering is for Aaron and his sons. It is very holy. It is their share of the food offerings burned for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y el resto de la ofrenda de cereal [será] para Aarón y para sus hijos, [cosa] santísima de las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Lo que quede de la ofrenda de cereal será para Aarón y sus hijos; es una porción santísima, tomada de las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El resto de la ofrenda de cereal es para Aarón y sus hijos. Es muy santo. Es la parte que les toca de las ofrendas quemadas para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le reste de l’offrande végétale [sera] pour Aaron et pour ses fils, une [chose] très sainte parmi les offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ce qui reste de l’offrande végétale revient à Aaron et à ses fils : c’est une part très sainte, prise sur les offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le reste de l’offrande végétale est pour Aaron et ses fils. C’est très saint. C’est leur part des offrandes brûlées pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na kinachobaki cha sadaka ya nafaka [ni] cha Haruni na wanawe, [kitu] kitakatifu kabisa katika sadaka za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} za kuteketezwa kwa moto.
sw.B: Kitakachobaki cha sadaka ya nafaka ni cha Haruni na wanawe; ni sehemu takatifu kabisa, iliyotolewa katika sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Sehemu iliyobaki ya sadaka ya nafaka ni ya Haruni na wanawe. Ni takatifu sana. Ni fungu lao la sadaka zilizochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: the remainder ... most holy: as in verse 3
decisions.reason: The rule for the baked offerings repeats verse 3 word for word. See the notes there.

decisions.choice: very holy
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, Readable says "very holy".

source.text: כָּל־הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תֵעָשֶׂ֖ה חָמֵ֑ץ כִּ֤י כָל־שְׂאֹר֙ וְכָל־דְּבַ֔שׁ לֹֽא־תַקְטִ֧ירוּ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Any grain offering which you will bring near to Yahweh not will be made leaven, for any leaven and any honey not you will make smoke from it [as a] fire offering to Yahweh.

en.L: Any grain offering that you bring near to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shall not be made leavened, for no leaven and no honey shall you make smoke from it [as] an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: No yeast may go into any grain offering you bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Neither yeast nor honey is ever to be turned into smoke as a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do not put yeast in any grain offering you bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Never burn yeast or honey as a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Ninguna ofrenda de cereal que {{plural_you:presenten|presentéis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} se hará con levadura, porque ninguna levadura ni ninguna miel {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} humear de ella [como] ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Ninguna ofrenda de cereal que {{plural_you:traigan|traigáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} llevará levadura. Nunca se hará subir en humo levadura ni miel como ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: No {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} levadura en ninguna ofrenda de cereal que {{plural_you:traigan|traigáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Nunca {{plural_you:quemen|queméis}} levadura ni miel como ofrenda en el fuego para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Aucune offrande végétale que vous ferez approcher {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ne sera faite avec du levain, car vous ne ferez fumer ni levain ni miel, rien de cela, [comme] offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Aucune offrande végétale que vous apportez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ne contiendra de levain. Jamais vous ne ferez monter en fumée ni levain ni miel en offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ne mettez pas de levain dans les offrandes végétales que vous apportez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Ne brûlez jamais de levain ni de miel comme offrande sur le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Sadaka yoyote ya nafaka mtakayomsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haitafanywa kwa chachu, kwa maana chachu yoyote wala asali yoyote hamtafukiza katika hiyo [kuwa] sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Sadaka yoyote ya nafaka mtakayomletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} isitiwe chachu. Kamwe msifukize chachu wala asali kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Msitie chachu katika sadaka yoyote ya nafaka mnayomletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kamwe msichome chachu wala asali kuwa sadaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: leavened ... leaven: dough made to rise, and the fermented dough that makes it rise
decisions.reason: Two words are used. The first describes bread that has been leavened; the second is the leaven itself, a lump of sour, fermented dough kept back to start the next batch. Neither may be burned on the altar. The text gives no reason here. Leaven was also forbidden during the Feast of Unleavened Bread (Exodus 12:15, 19; 13:7). Leavened bread could still be given to God where it was not burned: with the thanksgiving offering (7:13) and as the two loaves of the Feast of Weeks (23:17).

decisions.choice: honey: sweet syrup, from bees or from fruit
decisions.reason: The word is used of bees' honey (Judges 14:8) but also, it seems, of syrup made from dates or grapes. Honey is counted among the firstfruits of the land that the people brought (2 Chronicles 31:5), so it is not unclean; it is only kept off the altar. Like leaven, it could ferment.

decisions.choice: yeast
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "leaven" and "leavened". Balanced and Readable say "yeast", the word readers know for what makes dough rise, though the leaven of the Bible was sour dough rather than dried yeast.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:presenten|presentéis}}, {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} (plural) in verses 11-12, "tú" in verses 4-10 and 13-15
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from "you" singular to plural in verses 11 and 12, a rule for all Israel, and back to the singular in verse 13. Spanish follows it at every level, with the plural forms under the plural_you setting. French ("vous") and Swahili ("m-") follow it too.

source.text: קָרְבַּ֥ן רֵאשִׁ֛ית תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לֹא־יַעֲל֖וּ לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: [As an] offering of first [fruit] you will bring near them to Yahweh, but to the altar not they will go up for [an] odor of soothing.

en.L: [As] an offering of firstfruits you may bring them near to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but to the altar they shall not go up for an aroma of soothing.
en.B: As an offering of firstfruits you may bring such things to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but they must not go up on the altar as a soothing aroma.
en.R: You may bring them to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a gift from the first crops you harvest. But they must not be burned on the altar as a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: [Como] ofrenda de primicias {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} presentarlos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero al altar no subirán como aroma grato.
es.B: Como ofrenda de primicias {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} traer esas cosas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero no subirán al altar como aroma grato.
es.R: {{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} traerlas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como regalo de las primeras cosechas. Pero no se deben quemar en el altar como olor agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: [Comme] offrande de prémices, vous pourrez les faire approcher {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, mais sur l’autel ils ne monteront pas en odeur apaisante.
fr.B: Vous pourrez apporter ces choses {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} en offrande de prémices, mais elles ne monteront pas sur l’autel en odeur apaisante.
fr.R: Vous pouvez les apporter {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} comme un don pris sur vos premières récoltes. Mais il ne faut pas les brûler sur l’autel comme une odeur qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: [Kuwa] sadaka ya malimbuko mtaweza kumsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hivyo, lakini juu ya madhabahu havitapanda kuwa harufu ya kupendeza.
sw.B: Mnaweza kumletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} vitu hivyo kuwa sadaka ya malimbuko, lakini visipandishwe juu ya madhabahu kuwa harufu ya kupendeza.
sw.R: Mnaweza kumletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} vitu hivyo kuwa zawadi kutoka kwa mavuno yenu ya kwanza. Lakini visichomwe juu ya madhabahu kuwa harufu inayompendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: first: the first and best part of the harvest
decisions.reason: The word means beginning or first, and so the first and choicest part of what the land yields. Israel was to bring it to God's house (Exodus 23:19; Deuteronomy 26:1-11), and it was given to the priests (Numbers 18:12-13). Giving the first part acknowledged that the whole harvest came from God. Verse 14 uses a second word, for the first produce to ripen.

decisions.choice: them: leaven and honey, or what is made with them
decisions.reason: "Them" refers back to the leaven and honey of verse 11. Things made with them may be given to God among the firstfruits, as the two leavened loaves of 23:17 and the honey of 2 Chronicles 31:5 were, but they are not burned on the altar; they go to the priests.

decisions.choice: go up to the altar: be burned on the altar
decisions.reason: To "go up" on the altar is to be offered there and rise in smoke; the word for the burnt offering comes from the same verb (1:3).

decisions.choice: a gift from the first crops you harvest
decisions.reason: Readable explains "firstfruits" as the first crops of the harvest.

decisions.choice: "las primicias" (L, B); "las primeras cosechas" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: "primicias" for the first and best of the harvest (m1), here and for the second word in verse 14; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "les prémices" (L, B); "les premières récoltes" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: "prémices" for the first and best of the harvest (m1), here and for the second word in verse 14; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "malimbuko" (L, B); "mavuno ya kwanza" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Leviticus: "malimbuko" for the first and best of the harvest (m1), here and for the second word in verse 14; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְכָל־קָרְבַּ֣ן מִנְחָתְךָ֮ בַּמֶּ֣לַח תִּמְלָח֒ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֗ית מֶ֚לַח בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מֵעַ֖ל מִנְחָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ל כָּל־קָרְבָּנְךָ֖ תַּקְרִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And every offering of your grain offering with salt you will salt, and not you will let cease [the] salt of [the] covenant of your God from on your grain offering; with all your offerings you will bring near salt.

en.L: And every offering of your grain offering you shall salt with salt, and you shall not let the salt of the covenant of your God be missing from your grain offering; with all your offerings you shall bring near salt.
en.B: Every grain offering you present must be salted. Never let your grain offering lack the salt of your God's covenant. Salt is to go with every offering you bring.
en.R: Put salt on every grain offering. Salt is a sign of your God's lasting covenant, so never leave it out. Put salt on all your offerings.

es.L: Y toda ofrenda de tu ofrenda de cereal la sazonarás con sal, y no dejarás que falte la sal del pacto de tu Dios de tu ofrenda de cereal; con todas tus ofrendas presentarás sal.
es.B: Sazonarás con sal toda ofrenda de cereal que presentes. Nunca dejarás que a tu ofrenda de cereal le falte la sal del pacto de tu Dios. Con todas tus ofrendas llevarás sal.
es.R: Ponle sal a cada ofrenda de cereal. La sal es señal del pacto duradero de tu Dios, así que nunca la dejes fuera. Ponles sal a todas tus ofrendas.

fr.L: Et toute offrande de ton offrande végétale, tu la saleras avec du sel, et tu ne laisseras pas manquer le sel de l’alliance de ton Dieu sur ton offrande végétale ; avec toutes tes offrandes tu feras approcher du sel.
fr.B: Tu saleras toute offrande végétale que tu présentes. Tu ne laisseras jamais manquer à ton offrande végétale le sel de l’alliance de ton Dieu. Avec toutes tes offrandes, tu apporteras du sel.
fr.R: Mets du sel sur chaque offrande végétale. Le sel est le signe de l’alliance durable de ton Dieu : ne l’oublie donc jamais. Mets du sel sur toutes tes offrandes.

sw.L: Na kila sadaka ya sadaka yako ya nafaka utaitia chumvi, wala hutaiacha chumvi ya agano la Mungu wako ikose katika sadaka yako ya nafaka; pamoja na sadaka zako zote utasogeza chumvi.
sw.B: Utatia chumvi kila sadaka ya nafaka unayoitoa. Usiiache kamwe sadaka yako ya nafaka ikose chumvi ya agano la Mungu wako. Pamoja na kila sadaka utakayoleta, utatoa chumvi.
sw.R: Tia chumvi katika kila sadaka ya nafaka. Chumvi ni ishara ya agano la kudumu la Mungu wako, kwa hiyo usiiache kamwe. Tia chumvi katika sadaka zako zote.

decisions.choice: the salt of the covenant of your God: salt as a sign of the lasting covenant between God and Israel
decisions.reason: Salt keeps food from spoiling, and sharing salt at a meal was a sign of a bond between people (compare Ezra 4:14, "we eat the salt of the palace"). "A covenant of salt" in Scripture is one that does not decay: God's gift of the holy offerings to the priests (Numbers 18:19) and his gift of the kingship to David (2 Chronicles 13:5). The salt on every offering recalls that the worshiper comes to God within his covenant.

decisions.choice: with all your offerings: salt goes on every offering, not only on grain
decisions.reason: The last clause widens the rule from the grain offering to every offering. Salt was also put on burnt offerings (Ezekiel 43:24), and it was among the supplies for the temple (Ezra 6:9; 7:22).

decisions.choice: Salt is a sign of your God's lasting covenant
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the salt of the covenant" by saying that the salt is a sign of a covenant that lasts. The Hebrew does not say "sign"; the sense comes from the other uses of the phrase (Numbers 18:19).

source.text: וְאִם־תַּקְרִ֛יב מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה אָבִ֞יב קָל֤וּי בָּאֵשׁ֙ גֶּ֣רֶשׂ כַּרְמֶ֔ל תַּקְרִ֕יב אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And if you bring near [a] grain offering of firstfruits to Yahweh, fresh ears roasted in the fire, groats of fresh grain, you will bring near the grain offering of your firstfruits.

en.L: And if you bring near a grain offering of firstfruits to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, fresh ears roasted in the fire, crushed [kernels] of new grain, you shall bring near [as] the grain offering of your firstfruits.
en.B: When you present a grain offering of firstfruits to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, it is to be the new grain of the season, freshly ripe ears roasted over the fire and crushed. That is how you present the grain offering of your firstfruits.
en.R: If you bring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a grain offering from the first grain you harvest, roast the new heads of grain in the fire. Then crush them. Offer this as your grain offering of the first crops.

es.L: Y si presentas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda de cereal de primicias, espigas tiernas tostadas al fuego, grano nuevo triturado, presentarás [como] la ofrenda de cereal de tus primicias.
es.B: Cuando presentes {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda de cereal de primicias, será del grano nuevo de la temporada: espigas recién maduras, tostadas al fuego y trituradas. Así presentarás la ofrenda de cereal de tus primicias.
es.R: Si traes {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda de cereal de lo primero que cosechas, tuesta al fuego las espigas nuevas. Luego tritúralas. Ofrécelo como tu ofrenda de cereal de las primeras cosechas.

fr.L: Et si tu fais approcher {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une offrande végétale de prémices, [ce sont] des épis frais grillés au feu, du grain nouveau concassé, que tu feras approcher [comme] l’offrande végétale de tes prémices.
fr.B: Quand tu présenteras {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une offrande végétale de prémices, ce sera du grain nouveau de la saison : des épis à peine mûrs, grillés au feu et concassés. C’est ainsi que tu présenteras l’offrande végétale de tes prémices.
fr.R: Si tu apportes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une offrande végétale prise sur tes premières récoltes de grain, fais griller au feu les épis nouveaux. Ensuite, écrase-les. Offre cela comme offrande végétale de tes premières récoltes.

sw.L: Na ukimsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya nafaka ya malimbuko, masuke mabichi yaliyochomwa motoni, nafaka mpya iliyopondwa, utasogeza [kuwa] sadaka ya nafaka ya malimbuko yako.
sw.B: Utakapomtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya nafaka ya malimbuko, itakuwa nafaka mpya ya msimu: masuke yaliyoiva sasa hivi, yaliyokaangwa motoni na kupondwa. Hivyo ndivyo utakavyotoa sadaka ya nafaka ya malimbuko yako.
sw.R: Ukimletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya nafaka kutoka kwa mavuno yako ya kwanza, kaanga masuke mapya motoni. Kisha yaponde. Itoe hiyo kuwa sadaka yako ya nafaka ya mavuno ya kwanza.

decisions.choice: firstfruits: the first produce of the harvest to ripen
decisions.reason: This word is related to the word for a firstborn. It names the first grain and fruit to ripen each year, which belonged to God (Exodus 23:16, 19; Numbers 18:13). The Feast of Weeks is the day of the firstfruits of the wheat harvest (Exodus 34:22; Numbers 28:26). The "if" here suggests a gift a worshiper chooses to bring. Unlike the leavened firstfruits of verse 12, this offering is burned on the altar (verse 16).

decisions.choice: fresh ears roasted in the fire, crushed new grain: ripe grain parched and then crushed
decisions.reason: The first word means ears of grain just ripe; it gives its name to the month of Abib, when the barley ripened (Exodus 9:31; 13:4). The last word means fresh, new grain (23:14; 2 Kings 4:42). The word for "crushed" occurs only here and in verse 16, and probably means grain that is coarsely ground. Roasted new grain was ordinary food at harvest time (Ruth 2:14).

decisions.choice: two descriptions of one offering
decisions.reason: The two phrases most likely describe the same offering: the fresh ears are first roasted and then crushed.

decisions.choice: roasted over the fire and crushed (Balanced); Then crush them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable join the two phrases into one action, roasting and then crushing, as the note above explains. Readable says "the first grain you harvest" for "firstfruits".

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֤ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָ֑ה מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put on it oil and place on it frankincense; [a] grain offering it [is].

en.L: And you shall put oil on it and place frankincense on it; it [is] a grain offering.
en.B: Add oil to it and place frankincense on top. This is a grain offering.
en.R: Add oil and put frankincense on top. It is a grain offering.

es.L: Y pondrás sobre ella aceite y colocarás sobre ella incienso; ofrenda de cereal [es].
es.B: Le añadirás aceite y le pondrás incienso encima. Es una ofrenda de cereal.
es.R: Añádele aceite y ponle incienso encima. Es una ofrenda de cereal.

fr.L: Et tu mettras de l’huile dessus et tu poseras de l’encens dessus ; c’[est] une offrande végétale.
fr.B: Tu y ajouteras de l’huile et tu mettras de l’encens dessus. C’est une offrande végétale.
fr.R: Ajoute de l’huile et mets de l’encens dessus. C’est une offrande végétale.

sw.L: Nawe utaweka mafuta juu yake na kutia ubani juu yake; [ni] sadaka ya nafaka.
sw.B: Utaongeza mafuta juu yake na kuweka ubani juu yake. Hii ni sadaka ya nafaka.
sw.R: Ongeza mafuta na uweke ubani juu yake. Ni sadaka ya nafaka.

decisions.choice: oil and frankincense: as in verse 1
decisions.reason: The offering of new grain is prepared like the offering of flour, with oil and frankincense. See the note at verse 1.

decisions.choice: it is a grain offering: the closing formula, as in verse 6
decisions.reason: The same short sentence closes the rule for the griddle offering in verse 6.

source.text: וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־אַזְכָּרָתָ֗הּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And will make smoke the priest its memorial portion, from its groats and from its oil, with all its frankincense, [a] fire offering to Yahweh.

en.L: And the priest shall make its memorial portion smoke, some of its crushed [grain] and some of its oil, with all its frankincense, an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The priest is to take some of the crushed grain and some of the oil, along with all of the frankincense, and turn this memorial portion into smoke as a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The priest will burn some of the crushed grain and some of the oil, with all the frankincense. This is the part that is a reminder. It is a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, burned on the fire.

es.L: Y el sacerdote hará humear su porción memorial, parte de su grano triturado y parte de su aceite, con todo su incienso, ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: El sacerdote tomará parte del grano triturado y parte del aceite, junto con todo el incienso, y hará subir en humo esta porción memorial como ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: El sacerdote quemará parte del grano triturado y parte del aceite, con todo el incienso. Es la parte que sirve de recuerdo. Es una ofrenda para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, quemada en el fuego.

fr.L: Et le prêtre fera fumer sa portion commémorative, une partie de son grain concassé et une partie de son huile, avec tout son encens, offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le prêtre prendra une partie du grain concassé et une partie de l’huile, avec tout l’encens, et fera monter cette portion commémorative en fumée, en offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le prêtre brûlera une partie du grain écrasé et une partie de l’huile, avec tout l’encens. C’est la part qui sert de rappel. C’est une offrande pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, brûlée sur le feu.

sw.L: Naye kuhani ataifukiza sehemu yake ya ukumbusho, sehemu ya nafaka yake iliyopondwa na sehemu ya mafuta yake, pamoja na ubani wake wote, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kuhani atachukua sehemu ya nafaka iliyopondwa na sehemu ya mafuta, pamoja na ubani wote, na kuifukiza sehemu hiyo ya ukumbusho kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kuhani atachoma sehemu ya nafaka iliyopondwa na sehemu ya mafuta, pamoja na ubani wote. Hii ndiyo sehemu ya kukumbusha. Ni sadaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, iliyochomwa kwa moto.

decisions.choice: its memorial portion ... with all its frankincense: as in verse 2
decisions.reason: The priest burns a portion of the new grain and oil with all the frankincense, as with the flour in verse 2. See the note on the memorial portion there.

decisions.choice: the rest goes to the priests
decisions.reason: The chapter does not repeat it here, but the rule of verses 3 and 10 applies: what is not burned is eaten by the priests.
